text:
Professor Jem Corcoran teaches in the Applied Mathematics department at University of Colorado - Boulder. Overall rating 4.8/5 from 15 ratings; average difficulty 3.3/5; 100.0% would take again.

Review 1 [APPM4560] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Genuinely amazing professor... nothing more needs to be said

Review 2 [APPM4560] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): So! Good! One of the best professors I've ever had - if I could take every math class with her for the rest of my life, I would do it in a heartbeat.

Review 3 [APPM4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=5.0): Jem is one of the best professor I ever met at CU. Her lecture is heavy but fun. She really care students in her class and she is super friendly to people not only her students. She tries her best to help the students understand the material in class and in her office hours. Take her class and you will recieve the best experience learning math.

Review 4 [APPM4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): The best professor I have met.

Review 5 [APPM4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): I am graduating in 2 weeks and I can easily say that Professor Corcoran is hands down the best professor I have had in my college career. On the advice of my roommates, I waited two years to sync my schedule so that I could take her class and I'm so glad that I did. This professor goes above and beyond to make sure everyone is learning. A+!

Review 6 [APPM4520] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): Awesome

Review 7 [APPM4560] (quality=5.0, difficulty=1.0): Very nice, clear and helpful.

Review 8 [APPM4570] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Jem made statistics fun and interesting!  I didn't have any classes around the same time as this one, but I still found the motivation to attend class every day.  She made the subject clear and simple, lots of pertinent examples.  I wish I could take all my APPM classes with her.

Review 9 [MATH4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): She made a pretty boring subject entertaining with effusiveness.  The homework was pretty tough, but not unbearable.  She is a great teacher and you should take her classes if you can.

Review 10 [MATH4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): best math class ever

Review 11 [MATH5520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=4.0): Most awesome. I take every class this professor teaches, whether I need it or not!

Review 12 [APPM1360] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): Awesome teacher!

Review 13 [APPM4520] (quality=5.0, difficulty=3.0): No Comments

Review 14 [APPM1360] (quality=4.0, difficulty=4.0): No Comments

Review 15 [APPM1360] (quality=5.0, difficulty=2.0): Best Calc II professor, very clear, very entertaining too.
